references.text: The original instruction for the dimensions of the curtains that was given to Moses on Mount Sinai. Exodus 36:9 describes the execution of this instruction.
The complete description of the tabernacle curtains that God commanded Moses to make, which is now being carried out in Exodus 36.
The preceding verse describing the material and decoration of the curtains made by the skilled craftsmen.
The following text describing how the curtains were fastened together with loops and hooks.
